meta.title: Rental Planner: booking calendar and rental management app
meta.desc: Booking calendar, payments, expenses and your team in one app. For apartments, cars, boats, pet hotels and any other rental.
app.name: Rental Planner
hero.lead: Bookings, finances and reports in one app.
plat.cap: Bookings from booking sites land in your calendar automatically
sph.title: One system for any rental
sph.sub: A unit can be anything: an apartment, a car, a boat or a kennel. The calendar, payments and reminders work the same way.
sph.flatsT: Short and long stays: check-ins, deposits, cleaning between guests and calendar sync with Airbnb and Booking.com.
sph.carsT: Pick-up and return, deposit, mileage from meter readings. See which cars are free on any date at a glance.
sph.boatsT: Departure and return times, prepayment, group size and the captain's contacts right in the booking card.
sph.petsT: Kennels and rooms as units, the pet's name and the owner's contacts, reminders about check-in and check-out.
sph.toolsT: Every hammer drill and generator as a separate unit: who took it, when it comes back and how much is still owed.
sph.bikesT: Seasonal rentals without spreadsheets: a calendar for every vehicle, deposits and message templates for customers.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Yes. Up to 2 units and bookings for the last month are free with no time limit. When you have more units or need reminders, statistics and receipts, switch to a paid plan.
faq.q2: Will it work for cars, boats or a pet hotel?
faq.a2: It will. A unit can be anything: an apartment, a car, a boat, a kennel or a hammer drill. Choose your field on first launch, and the field names adapt to it.
faq.q3: How do I connect Airbnb and Booking.com?
faq.a3: On the Business plan, open a unit, tap “Calendar sync” and paste the iCal link from the booking site. Bookings appear in your calendar within 20-30 minutes, then everything updates automatically.
faq.q4: Can I work together with a manager?
faq.a4: Yes. On the Business plan, create a company and add members by email. Each member gets a role, units and permissions: for example, a manager sees bookings but not finances.
faq.q5: Is there a version for computers?
faq.a5: There is a web version and tablet support. You can sign in with a QR code from the app, no password needed. Data and subscription are shared across all devices.
faq.q6: How do I pay for a subscription?
faq.a6: In the App Store or Google Play. The subscription is tied to your account and works on every device, including the web version.
faq.q7: What happens to my data if I change phones?
faq.a7: Nothing bad: your data is stored in the cloud and tied to your account. Sign in on the new phone and everything will be there.
faq.q8: How do I avoid double bookings?
faq.a8: The app finds bookings that overlap by dates before two guests show up at the same door. Overlap search is available from the Basic plan. On the Business plan, bookings from Airbnb, Booking.com and Agoda come into the same calendar via iCal, and your calendar goes back to block the busy dates.
faq.q9: Can I export bookings and payments to Excel?
faq.a9: Yes. The Premium plan includes full statistics and Excel export, handy to send to your accountant.
faq.q10: Does the app remind me about check-ins and payments?
faq.a10: Yes, on the Premium plan. The app reminds you about check-ins, check-outs and missing prepayments in advance, and message templates let you text the guest via Telegram or WhatsApp in one tap.
faq.q11: Is there an API for my website or CRM?
faq.a11: Yes, on the Business plan. Connect your own website or CRM via the API, the documentation is public.
faq.a12: Yes. You can use the calendar and bookings offline, and everything syncs once you are back online.
